{{Top}} {{Conjecture}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image= |name=Unidentified Imperial officer |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[9 ABY]], [[Nevarro]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 8: Redemption}} |species= |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Imperial Remnants]] **[[Gideon's Imperial remnant]] |masters= |apprentices= }} An '''Imperial officer''' served in [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|a remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] that operating under the leadership of [[Moff]] [[Gideon]], under whom they held the rank of an [[Imperial officer|officer]]. They were [[Death|killed]], however, by their own leader when, during the [[Clash on Nevarro]], the officer made the mistake of interrupting Gideon, who promptly slew his subordinate. ==Biography== {{Quote|Let me check on this thing. This is crazy. Any update yet?''"
"''That's a negative. Still waiting on confirmation. He just killed an officer for interrupting him, so this might take a while.''"
"''Thank you. Standing by still. Unbelievable.|[[JS-1975]] and an operator|}}During the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]], this individual held the rank of an [[officer]] in a remnant of the Galactic Empire under the leadership of Gideon, a Moff during the reign of [[Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]]. In [[9 ABY]]{{MandoDate|8}}, Gideon's remnant carried out a military occupation of the [[Nevarro City|capital city]] of [[Nevarro]], driving the majority of its residents away and using it as [[Imperial Remnant safe house|a base]] until conflict suddenly broke out between the remnant and a group comprising of the [[Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian warrior|warrior]] [[Din Djarin]], as well as his allies [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]] and former [[Magistrate]] [[Greef Karga]], which came to a standstill with the arrival of Gideon in [[Gideon's Outland TIE fighter|his Outland TIE fighter]]. However, during the course of events that followed this arrival, Gideon was interrupted by the Imperial officer, who was promptly marked for a death that was swiftly executed by their superior, an incident that was then reported to [[JS-1975]] and [[AP-1982]], who questioned this. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian: The Manga]]'' {{Mo}} *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 8: Redemption}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი იმპერიელი ოფიცერი (ქალაქი ნევარო) }} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Members of Gideon's Imperial remnant]] [[Category:Officers of the Galactic Empire]]
